title: OmniTensor runtime contract description version 1
description: What the running service speaks, answerable before any other call. A client that cannot ask this has to discover an unsupported method by calling it and reading the failure, which is indistinguishable from a service that is broken rather than older. Introspection alone would enumerate method names but not which version of each document body they accept.

version.description: Version of this description document, not of the contracts it describes.

methods.description: Every method the control socket dispatches, including this one.

schemas.description: Version of each named wire contract this service accepts and emits. A name absent here is a document this service does not speak.
